items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: With Ory and St. Cyr and Simeon and all.

ctx.x: Oh. I... The chant. The chant, yes. Yes. And the pearls. Uh-huh. I'll get those rings because I don't have any of them.
You're just about on all of those except a few of them were made in New York that you weren't on. Two-thirds of them you play the trumpet on. Uh-huh. With Ory and St. Cyr and Simeon and all.
